Firebase._comment_ServiceAccountJson: Do NOT put the service account JSON here. It is read from the Secret Manager / secret store at runtime under the key 'Firebase:ServiceAccountJson'. In Development, run: dotnet user-secrets set "Firebase:ServiceAccountJson" "<contents of your service account .json file>" from the VarsityLoop project folder. See README.md.
Firebase._comment_ApiKey: This is the Web API key from Firebase Console > Project Settings > General. Used for client REST auth calls (sign-in/sign-up/password reset).

AppSettings._comment: Used only for first-run bootstrap logic to grant SuperAdmin role. Not a hardcoded credential.
